name: Gas-flow actuation qualifier
summary: A gas-flow qualifier identifies operation responding to gas movement.
description: A gas-flow qualifier identifies operation responding to gas movement. Gas-flow actuation identifies the moving-gas condition used by the device. It is not equivalent to a static pressure condition, even where both participate in one ventilation or process sequence.
Document the monitored path and the resulting electrical input. A separate description is needed for any alarm delay, operating threshold or fan permissive.
readingNotes: Distinguish the gas process from any adjacent liquid-flow or pressure measurement.
Gas flow and gas pressure are different process quantities.
drawingChecklist: Identify the associated device, circuit or diagram boundary.
